description: ICH E9(R1), Addendum on Estimands and Sensitivity Analysis in Clinical Trials. The normative definition of the estimand framework. USDM models that framework structurally but does not define it, and Phase 4 gates on the SAP actually defining estimands, so the definition has to come from here.
pinning: ICH publishes PDFs at stable URLs with no version control system, so there is no commit to pin. The pin here is the sha256 plus the retrieval date. Re-download and re-hash to detect a silent replacement at the same URL.

files.name: ICH_E9R1_Addendum.pdf
files.role: Defines the estimand as a construct with attributes (population, variable, intercurrent event handling, population-level summary) and describes sensitivity analysis. Read this before making any claim about what an estimand attribute means.
